## 2026-11-03 — 0.6.0.213: the app gives way to the game (stutters)

- A player (havudigames, forwarded by the owner, 03.11.2026): «с запущенной прогой, время от времени у меня начали появлятся статтеры в игре, они идут минуты 2 потом пропадают».
- Candidates found in the code (nothing measured on his PC):
  1. The background update. Today's 10–15 releases each set it off. A partial update downloads 6 streams at once with brotli, then synchronously rebuilds and SHA-256-checks the whole ~200 MB `app.asar` in the main process, at full speed. It was held back only in a raid by the logs, so it ran in menus, the hideout and loading screens.
  2. The quest screen reading: a full-display BitBlt and a Tesseract pass every 1.2 s for 90 s after each game start, and back to back on the Tasks, story and trader screens. Its pace is unchanged.
- `electron/appUpdate.ts`: nothing is downloaded or built in the background while the game runs at all (`gameRunning`, main.ts: the game's process). It waits for the game to close or for the next start. «Установить обновление» pressed by the player still downloads at once; the raid gate is as before.
- New `electron/gamePriority.ts` (+ test), called from `electron/screenTuning/index.ts` tick (every 500 ms, Windows): the app's main process runs below normal priority while the game's window is in front (the OCR worker, a partial update, log parsing), and normal in its own window. Set only on a change.
- Tests: `electron/appUpdatePolicy.test.ts` (no background download while the game runs, then one after it closes; the button downloads at once), `electron/gamePriority.test.ts`; `npm run typecheck`; electron tsc; eslint on the changed files; full vitest: 2537 passed; the 11 failing here are this PC only (server/node_modules without cors, Linux paths, CRLF), as before.
- Deployment: release/production 0.6.0.213. It changes the main process, so it takes effect at the app's next start.
- Risks: not measured on the player's PC. If the stutters come with the game's start or the Tasks screen, the screen reading's pace is the next thing to look at. Background updates now wait for the game to close, so a player who never closes the game gets them at the next start.

## 2026-11-03 — 0.6.0.214: the Windows installer (the app's part; the publisher waits for the owner)

- Owner, 03.11.2026: «сделай установочный файл, можно выбрать куда установить. установил и приложение распаковывается туда, после этого пусть обновляется частями, и запускается быстро». In the migration window only «Raid OS теперь устанавливается как обычная программа» with «Установить» / «Позже» («это не нужно писать» about explanations).
- Why: the portable exe unpacks 630 MB (281 files) into a new %TEMP% folder on every start, and twice, because the administrator relaunch (`electron/experimental/elevation.ts`) runs the portable exe again. That gave 1–5 min starts with the whole PC hanging (player havudigames), and taskbar or desktop pins pointed at the deleted temp folder.
- App (`claude/windows-installer`, `19732ae5`):
  - `electron/appInstall.ts` (new): `installedExe()` — an `Uninstall *.exe` next to the packaged exe, not portable; `updatableExe()`; `fetchSetupManifest` (`/downloads/setup.json`); `runSetupWhenClosed` — a hidden cmd waits for this process, then runs `/S --updated --force-run /D=<folder>`; `openSetupForPortable` (writes `userData/portable-migration.json`); `removeMigratedPortable` — the installed copy's first start removes that portable exe and its `.update`.
  - `electron/updateManifest.ts` + `scripts/sign-client-release.mjs`: `SETUP_PAYLOAD_PREFIX = 'raidos-setup-v1'`, `verifiedSetupManifest` (client only), `signClientSetup` / `--setup`. An installer signature never passes for the exe's, nor the reverse.
  - `electron/appUpdate.ts`: an installed copy takes releases in parts as before (`relaunchWhenClosed` waits for its own pid; the portable exe still for the launcher's). A release parts cannot bring comes as the installer of that very build (signed setup.json, same build) into `userData/updates/RaidOSSetup.exe`, run silently after the app quits; with no such installer it is 'latest' — an installed copy never takes the portable exe. `installerOffer()` / `installFromPortable()` for the portable exe.
  - `electron/deltaUpdate.ts`: `fetchDeltaInfo` for an installed copy too; `relaunchWhenClosed(exe, waitFor)`.
  - `src/components/InstallerOffer.tsx` (mounted after `<UpdateButton />`), IPC `update:installer-offer` / `update:install-setup` (preload.ts + preload.cjs), English in `src/i18n/uiEnglishServer.ts`. Shown only once the site publishes a signed setup.json, so this release changes nothing visible.
  - `package.json`: `build.nsis` (assisted, per-user by default, folder choice, desktop + Start menu shortcuts, run after finish, ru/en, `RaidOSSetup ${version}.exe`), script `dist:win:setup`.
  - Website: «Скачать для Windows» (`DownloadPage.tsx`, `CabinetPage.tsx`) hands out `/downloads/RaidOSSetup.exe` once `/downloads/setup.json` answers (`website/src/hooks/setupDownload.ts`); until then the portable exe and the old text.
- Publisher (`docs/coordination/ops-reference/auto-release.mjs`, NOT installed on the VPS): after the portable build, `--win nsis --prepackaged release-client/win-unpacked` (the very same app, so installed copies take the same partial updates), `signClientSetup`, publish `downloads/RaidOSSetup.exe` + `setup.json` (an older pair is removed), post-publish checks of both. Any failure there releases without an installer as before. `/download/windows` stays the portable exe for the old copies' updates. `build-repair-release.mjs` unchanged (portable only).
- Blocker on the VPS: no Wine. electron-builder makes the NSIS uninstaller on Linux by running the installer under Wine (`app-builder-lib/out/targets/nsis/NsisTarget.js`). Installing Wine and the publisher script (`install-auto-release.mjs`, root) waits for the owner.
- Tests: `electron/appInstall.test.ts`, `electron/appUpdate.installed.test.ts`, `electron/updateManifest.test.ts` (installer and exe signatures not interchangeable, the script's `--setup` text), `electron/appUpdate.delta.test.ts` (the launcher's pid), `src/components/InstallerOffer.test.tsx` (ru/en), `website/src/pages/DownloadPage.test.tsx`; `npm run typecheck`, electron tsc, website tsc, eslint; full vitest 2566 passed; the 11 failing here fail the same without this change (this PC: server/node_modules without cors, Linux paths, CRLF).
- Local Windows build: `electron-builder --win nsis portable` on this PC (a test build «Raid OS Test», TRIAL_LAUNCHES=50, its own data folder): RaidOSSetup 202 MB and the portable exe 202 MB; `resources` has no app-update.yml, so installed copies match the published partial update. Not installed on the owner's PC yet (software installation: owner's OK). `--prepackaged` skips packing (no afterPack, no fuses), so the VPS installer contains the client win-unpacked byte for byte.
- Deployment: release/production 0.6.0.214 (the app part and the website switch, both inert until setup.json exists).
- Risks: the installed path is not yet tried on a real PC by a player; per-machine installs («для всех пользователей») updated silently were not tried; an installer run from the elevated app installs elevated (same user).

## 2026-11-03 — the one-time two days of 02.11 start at the next sign-in in an app (database only)

- Owner, 03.11.2026: «все те кому мы добавили пробный период 2 дня, должен активироваться после входа в приложение, даже если они уже зашли, все равно сделай при новом входе с данного времени, отчет двух дней, кроме тех кто сейчас онлайн».
- The bonus of 02.11 15:39:35 UTC (`server/src/services/trialBonus.ts`, 485 accounts, each with the popup «Вам зачислено 2 дня пробного периода») had set `trial_ends_at` = its start + 2 days, so the days ran from then.
- Done on the server database at 09:44 UTC, as the service user `raidos-api`. The script was in the scratchpad, not added to the repository.
  - A backup first: `/var/lib/raidos/backups/companion-before-trial-defer-202611030944.sqlite` (VACUUM INTO, mode 600).
  - 446 accounts: `trial_ends_at` back to when the bonus began and `trial_pending_ms` = 2 days. This is the mechanism new accounts use: `AccountStore.claimTrialDevice`, on the next `POST /v1/entitlement` (the app's start), sets the end to max(now, paid days) + 2 days. That runs before the access check, so the app never shows «Нужна подписка» first.
  - Each row was changed only if unchanged since it was read and not online (`last_seen_at` within 10 min, `ONLINE_WINDOW_MS`). Audit `subscription.trial-bonus-deferred` {count 446, onlineKept 17, paidKept 1, firstPeriodKept 21}.
- Left as they were (39):
  - 17 online then;
  - 1 that paid since;
  - 21 whose first, longer free period (a streamer's code) still runs: their bonus has not begun and starts after it. A pending start now would have cut that period short (claimTrialDevice counts from now).
- Of the 446, 402 had not opened an app since the bonus; 44 had.
- Checked read-only after: 446 waiting with exactly 2 days, 39 running as before, `/health` 200, the database files still `raidos-api`, mode 600.
- Risks:
  - Until they sign in, these accounts have no running free period: the app shows the paywall only if it is opened without reaching the server.
  - The 21 can be moved too after a small server change (`claimTrialDevice`: a pending start after a free period still running), if the owner wants.

## 2026-11-03 — 0.6.0.215: waiting free days wait behind a running free period (the 21 accounts)

- Owner, 03.11.2026, on the 21 accounts left out of the move above (a first, longer free period still running): «Да, и их тоже».
- `server/src/services/accountStore.ts` `claimTrialDevice`: free days waiting for a sign-in (`trial_pending_ms`) keep waiting while a free period still runs (`trial_ends_at` > now). They start at the first sign-in after it ends: max(now, paid days) + the days. New accounts (no `trial_ends_at`) and the 446 moved accounts (their `trial_ends_at` already past) are unchanged. ## 2026-11-03 — 0.6.0.222: the portable exe's leftover folders in %TEMP% go at the next start

- A player, via the owner, 03.11.2026, with a screenshot of %TEMP%: «он просто в темпе все файлы хранит и они там остаются мусором… Подчеркнул все папки которые создаются с каждым новым запуском» (nsi439F.tmp, nsiAEC3.tmp, nsr20F0.tmp, nsyED9F.tmp, nsyB63F.tmp, nsxEACE.tmp — one a start).
- Why: electron-builder's portable stub (`unpackDirName: true` → `$PLUGINSDIR\app`) unpacks the app into a new nsXNNNN.tmp on every start and removes it the moment the window's process ends; the app's other processes still hold «Raid OS.exe» and its libraries then, and a shutdown with the app open never gets there. Up to 630 MB a folder.
- Commit caf9f0f8:
  - `electron/appInstall.ts` `removePortableLeftovers(gameRunning, temp)`: such a folder goes when its `app` folder holds a `Raid OS*.exe`, it is not this copy's own, it was left over an hour ago and its exe opens for writing (a running exe does not — tried on Windows 10; a folder a running exe is in DOES rename, so renaming is no test). It is renamed `<name>.raidos-old` first, so what a removal leaves half done goes at the next start. Stops while the game runs. Only the packaged Windows app.
  - `electron/main.ts`: a minute after the start, the game check is `isTarkovRunning() !== false`.
- Tests: `electron/appInstall.test.ts` (old, the owner edition's, half removed go; this copy's own, a fresh one, a running one, another program's nsXNNNN.tmp, chrome_BITS stay; the game running; not packaged). A one-off run on Windows with a real running exe: its folder stayed, the idle one went, then it went after the exe ended. `npm run typecheck`, electron tsc, eslint.
- Deployment: release/production 0.6.0.222, in the next batch window (13:00 Bangkok).
- Remaining: the cause stays until the installer (RaidOSSetup.exe) is published — Wine on the VPS and the publisher wait for the owner. Folders from another Windows user or another %TEMP% are not looked at.

## 2026-11-03 — 0.6.0.223: security review fixes; the installer's picture, RaidOS folder and all-users install

- Owner, 03.11.2026: «проверь на безопасность наше приложение… могут ли подменить ключ вытащить апи…», «могут ли подменить ответ для сервера о том что есть ложная подписка», then «Да, всё по порядку». Two read-only reviewers; findings re-checked in code. Full list: side-session notes `security-audit-2026-11-03.md`.
- Answers that hold (no change): a forged subscription gets nothing from the server (the server never reads the client's entitlement; /v1/catalog, /v1/data/*, /v1/players/*, /v1/live/* check session + server-side paid access + bound device on every request); update signatures cannot be swapped (Ed25519, private key off the server); no secrets in the shipped app; the desktop page already has a strict CSP (`src/app/contentSecurityPolicy.ts` — the reviewer's CSP finding was wrong).
- Fixes (one commit each):
  - 06171dc3 `server/src/services/bezebeeMail.ts`: a BZB sale letter is vouched only by BZB's DKIM signature or DMARC; quoted strings and (comments) of Authentication-Results — the envelope sender's own words — are dropped first; SPF no longer counts (a crafted envelope «"x;spf=pass smtp.mailfrom=a@bezebee.com"@evil» read as a pass → free subscription).
  - 895dab54 `electron/hiddenScript.ts` (+ `electron/trial.ts`): the update/restart/installer helper .cmd/.vbs go to %SystemRoot%\Temp under a new UUID name, created only if absent (a standard user cannot change an administrator's file there; %TEMP% let any program rewrite the script during its pauses → commands as administrator).
  - 22618c88 `electron/deltaBoot.ts` `stagedFilesVerified`, `electron/boot.ts`, `electron/deltaUpdate.ts`: a start with administrator rights (System32\config\systemprofile listable) checks every packed and unpacked file of the staged build that can run against the signed header's SHA-256 (not 3D models, pictures, video, source maps, OCR models): ~0.3 s for this release on the owner's PC; an interface-only update checks dist/ (~35 ms). A start without the rights checks the header as before.

- Owner, 04.11.2026: «Если они нажимают Вайп или Престиж, соответственно, квестов у человека не будет, и он все проходит заново. То есть ему не нужны старые логи» and «кнопка сброс будет, просто сбросить все. Но квесты будут, ну, логи опять находиться, которые были». This replaces the decision of 15.10.2026 («находило все актуальные… даже если просто сделали сброс приложения») for these two buttons; for «Сброс» it stands.
- 9df810e0 client: `floorAfterReset` (`src/domain/progress.ts`). «Престиж +», «Вайп»: the press becomes the mode's floor (`logResetAt`), no pending marker. «Сброс»: only the game's own proven reset stays, a floor an earlier press set goes (`appResetTimes`), so it undoes a press by mistake. A new nickname: unchanged, a pending marker. The dialogs and notices say so, RU and EN.
- One deliberate exception: if the logs proved the game's own reset up to 7 days before the press, that reset is the floor. Otherwise a player who did the prestige in the game, took quests and only then pressed «Престиж +» to choose the badge would lose quests he really holds.
- Server: `POST /v1/me/progress/:mode/reset { at, floor }` keeps the floor as the character's reset; without `floor` (a «Сброс», an older app) no floor is kept as before. Log pushes carry it as their `resetAt`, so a server that had no character yet keeps nothing older, and marks and story readings older than it are refused (existing guards). The account's other devices hear it as `scope.resetAt` and drop what they hold from before it. `beforeModeReset` now also uses `logResetAt`: a Tarkov.dev level or a remote objective from before the floor does not come back.
- Not checked on a real game prestige or wipe, a real phone or the packed app. Checked through real log text in `src/state/prestigeDetection.test.tsx` and `src/quests/questEngine.regression.test.tsx` (local time and UTC+7), and over HTTP in `server/src/routes/me.test.ts`.
- Tests rewritten that held the old decision: PrestigeResetButton, modeReset, prestigeDetection, questEngine.regression. New: press and old logs by button, a press soon after the game's own reset, a long-ago reset, «Сброс» undoing a press, the nickname, the server's floor, the push carrying it. `npx vitest run` here: 2714 passed, 11 failed in 7 files, the environment failures known from before. `npm run typecheck` clean, eslint 0 errors. Server me, accounts, supportChat, persistence tests pass; `support chat screenshots: count, type, size…` failed in 1 of 5 runs with `fetch failed: ECONNRESET` on a refused large body, passed in the others: a Windows socket flake of that test, not this change.
- Deployment: goes with the 20:00 Bangkok batch, server and app together. A server older than this refuses `floor` with 400 and the reset stays queued until it is updated.
- Risks: a press hides quests really held but taken before it, when the logs proved no game reset in the 7 days before: they return when the game logs their next event, when the Tasks screen is read, or with «Сброс». Markers of «Престиж +» / «Вайп» pressed before this release keep working as they did. A press made signed out stays local: the server and the other devices do not hear of it.

- Owner, on the report of 0.6.0.232, through the RaidOS session (his words checked in its transcript): «1 да, просто выложи обновление сейчас и все», «2 оставить только при первом запуске, что бы прошла синхронизация, больше сканировать не надо так как логи новых и закрытых квестов будут появляться», «3 не надо», «4 да». So a manual release, this once.
- 416ccfa4 `src/import/tableSync.ts`, `src/components/StoryScreenScanner.tsx`: the table is read until the mode's first sync ended, then passed over at the slow pace. What counts as the first start: one for each mode of each profile on each PC (`ModeProgress.tableSync`, sent nowhere), so PvP, PvE and the season apart, and a new PC has its own. It does not end before the table was really read: no time limit; a visit counts with two fresh readings naming a quest; it ends on the whole list read twice alike, or from the second visit on when a visit adds no quest and 75% of the trader quests the logs hold open were read (a player holds 39 current quests on average, about nine rows a page, so this says the list was scrolled), or after 6 visits whatever they showed. «Сброс», «Вайп / Престиж» and a new nickname build the mode anew, a new character or the game's own reset in the logs drops the state: that mode's sync opens again, the others keep theirs. Still read: story pane, mode selection, traders' screen; on demand «Найти квесты по экрану» and the owner's grant, both kept on purpose: the first is the player's way back.
- The one exception to the owner's word, made on purpose: every player already here has no such state, so gets one more read with the mended reader. Only that brings back a real quest of the 18 titles. Without it «a real one is back when «Задания» is next open» would no longer be true.
- The date of the 18 titles: not a new fixed one. A fixed date had to be before this update reached a PC (a real quest read by the new reader before it would go for good once the sync ended), and then missed what an old app writes after it, until that PC updates. Now each PC's own: records from before it began the mode's sync go (`tableSync.startedAt`, `withQuestChain`), so this update is closed exactly on every PC. A device with no reader has no such time and keeps them: the PC's copy decides there. `READER_MENDED_AT` is gone. Left: an old app on a second PC writing after the first began, through the account's copy.
- Decision 3 (read again all old screen records): not done, by his word.
- Decision 4, levels, `src/data/questCorrections.ts` (pinned, applied on every catalog build, the server's too): «Конвоир» 46 -> 36, «Путь охотника. Непреклонный» 55 -> 33. ## 2026-11-05 — 0.6.0.242: the server's load and download speed; «Добавить в текущие»

- Commit `dc8202c8`. Owner: «почему на сервере сейчас ЦП сильно загружено … почему сервер очень медленно отдает лаунчер». Found: `access.log` went from 1.5–2 million lines a day to 12–14 million from 31.10. 9.9 of 10.2 million requests in 17.8 h came from the desktop apps, about 200 of them making nearly all of it, up to 227 a minute each, 733 thousand answered 429. One busy client's requests show the circle, every 1 to 3 s: `POST /v1/me/objectives/:mode/sync` (`progressChanged` on every call), `/progress/:mode/manual` and `/story/:mode` (on any non-empty body) move the account's version, `GET /v1/me/social-events` answers at once, `onAccountChange` in `serverSync.ts` reloads everything and syncs again. Why it began on 31.10 exactly was not established: that reload is from 17.10, and the releases of 31.10 (0.6.0.138–148) changed what is synced.
- Fix on the server, so it works for apps of any version: `syncStory`, `syncManualMarks`, `syncDeferredQuests` and `objectives.sync` take `onChange`, called only when a row really changed. A value held back to the server's clock counts as newer at every sync, so it says nothing (a PC clock far ahead must not start the circle again). - The check is in `main.js`, not in the exe, and the lock belongs to the data folder, so an installed copy, a portable one and both editions on one PC count as one copy. A copy the app starts itself (`--updated`, `--server-mode`, `--elevated-relaunch`) waits up to 5 s for the lock.
- Tests: typecheck and eslint clean; 17 unit tests of `singleInstance` and `deltaBoot`. Real `main.js` in a temporary data folder at equal rights: second start exits in 234 ms, six at once all exit, one window, the window comes forward, a copy started by the app gives up after 5 s, works after a crash of the first copy.
- Owner's test, 05.11: the portable owner exe of `ab562c5b` (`Raid OS 0.6.0-243.exe` on his Desktop), elevated first copy, unelevated further starts: no second window. This is the one case the harness cannot do, because the Windows prompt needs his click.

It started the staged build and the window loaded; second starts exit in 465–569 ms with no window; on a build not yet confirmed a second start leaves no `pending` and no `bad`; 3 rounds of six starts at once all exit, no windows, no verdict on the build; after a crash of the first copy the next start takes the lock. The first copy ran without administrator rights there.
- Paths read in the code: `installFromPortable` opens the installer and quits at once, so the installer's start at its last page finds no copy. `runSetupWhenClosed` and `relaunchWhenClosed` wait for the process id before they start anything.
- Applies at the next start: a release that changes the main process is never loaded into an open window.
- Remaining risks. A copy that hangs with no window makes every further start open nothing until it is ended in Task Manager; before this change a new start would have opened. An old copy open when this build is staged holds no lock, so a start in that moment still opens a second copy, once, until the app is restarted. Closing: in the first 3 test runs the process stayed 11, 29 and 14 s after its window closed; in the next 10 runs 0.14–0.29 s, same script and same files. Cause not established. In the one run with a probe at that moment the lock was free at +193 ms while the process was still running, so a reopen should work, but no probe overlapped a long stay.

## 2026-11-05 — 0.6.0.251: «Отчёты»: a safe unattended run, the schedule off

- Owner: «Да, подготовь», to a limited key and a safe run, and turning the schedule on only after his word. It is off: no Windows task exists, and the task of the Claude app stays manual.
- Why: the agent read text anybody can write while holding the server's root key, a shell, and the right to push to `release/production`. The review's finding from 0.6.0.245.
- `scripts/reports-run.mjs`: a plain script does one run and holds the keys, and Claude is called only when there is something to do, so an empty run spends none of the limit. The analysis is `claude -p --restricted --strict-mcp-config --tools Read,Grep,Glob`: no commands, no network, no settings, files only in the agent's folder and the report's pictures, the report through stdin, and only `summary` and `plan` of its schema get out. The work gets only `approvedPlan` (`job()` no longer gives `player` or `analysis`) and a short list of checks to run; the script commits, pushes and calls the server. At most 5 analyses a run and 40 a day; three bad answers and a report waits for the owner.
- What goes out unattended is decided by the script, not the model: `sensitiveFiles` (payments, subscriptions, keys, sign-in, accounts, invitations, the release, `.github/`, `package.json`, this agent) and more than 40 files become «Не реализовано»; types, vitest with the known failures forgiven, and server tests come before a push; no job starts while `EscapeFromTarkov.exe` runs or a release is on. Each fix gets its own version and row in `updateHistory.json`, and a work log entry.

- Status: done in branch `claude/quest-tree` (from `origin/release/production` at 2619ad4a). Not pushed, not released: the release session takes the branch. Agent: Claude.
- On the owner's word: the «Капа» tab left `src/pages/QuestsPage.tsx` (its four quests stay on the Overview, `KappaProgress.tsx` is untouched; the small badge «Капа: выполнено N из 4» in the page's header stays, the owner did not name it). An old `?filter=kappa` opens «Все» with the quest it asked for. `belongsInQuestSection` lost the `kappa` section.
- «Хронология» has two buttons, «Каталог заданий» (as it was) and «Дерево квестов» (`?view=tree`, `&lane=` a trader or `all`). `QuestsPage.tsx`: a dozen lines only, the rest in `src/quests/tree/`.
- How the tree is built (`questTreeModel.ts`, `questTreeLayout.ts`): the game opens a quest by a chain (`questRequirements`, the status engine's own) or by a stage of its trader (dialogue, line level, loyalty: `traderChronologyGroups`, the catalog's own order). Which quest raises a line's level is not in the data, so no line is drawn from a quest to a stage. Each trader has a lane, each loyalty level a row, the stages follow on the row's rail, a stage's quests hang under it, a chain goes right. A link between traders, or an extra requirement from another stage of the same trader, is a chip on both sides instead of a line across the tree; a chip leads to the quest. The story chapters are the last lane, in their order, with no links between them (the data has none).
- PC: a scrolling box with the tree scaled inside: wheel scrolls, Ctrl + wheel and the buttons zoom, dragging moves the view (a press on a quest stays a click), Tab walks the quests. Search is the page's field: the whole tree, a match in another lane moves there, «1 из 26» with arrows. A press opens the card beside the tree (the back button closes it) and lights up what comes before and after. Statuses come from `questAvailabilityOf` of the current mode; a completion the game did not report stays dashed. The phone (`QuestTreeOutline.tsx`) gets the same tree as an outline: stages, each quest under the one that opens it, links as words.
- Tests: `src/quests/tree/questTree.test.ts` stands on the real catalogs of all three modes (`questTree.catalog.fixture.json`, 170 KB, taken through the app's own pipeline; `RAIDOS_QUEST_TREE_FIXTURE=1 npx vitest run src/quests/tree/questTreeFixture.gen.test.ts` rewrites it): every quest once, no circles, no requirement lost, nothing overlaps. ## 2026-11-06 — A key goes once the objective it opens is ticked

- Status: done, commit `4f52280b` in branch `claude/quest-key-done`, on `release/production` at 0.6.0.259 with the log entry of the 33 quests on top; not pushed, not released: the session integrating the release takes the commit. Agent: Claude.

- Cause: `src/data/catalogSource.ts` added the keys of `neededKeys` with no objective and then skipped the same key of the objective's `requiredKeys`, so nothing could tell which objective a key opens. The rule in `src/raidprep/objectives.ts` (`keyUsed`, `usedQuestKeys`, `openRequiredItems`): a key is needed until all its objectives are ticked; a key naming none stays with its quest. Used by: «Требования рейда» on the Overview (its row opens on the next objective), the briefing with locked doors, «Ключи для квестов», «Убежище и квесты» (a used key counts as collected), a squad mate's needs, the in-raid item info, «Требуемые предметы» and «Предметы» of the quest cards, the owner's curated requirements, the phone's quest peek, «Отложенные квесты» and the favourites they add. `src/pages/QuestKeysPage.tsx`: a quest with its key used goes to the key's done list, the key to «Больше не нужны» when none is left; the subtitle now says «Ключ нужен, пока не выполнены цели, которые он открывает.», RU and EN.

PvP, PvE and Season stay apart: a tick is read from the mode's own progress.
- Checked in a real browser, real catalog, PvP, «Инвентаризация» made current in a test profile: the key on the Overview, the card and «Нужны» in «Ключи для квестов»; the tick on the card takes it off all three, the quest stays current and the key moves to «Больше не нужны»; taken back from the map's window, it returns to all three. ## 2026-11-06 — Start intro «Шов»: PC, phone, site (branch `claude/startup-intro`, not released)

- **Owner's choice:** variant 1 of four, then for the site: «полная анимация эмблемы и открытие сайта». The stitch runs round the patch, the R is stamped into it, the name rises letter by letter. Commit `2f4fc696`.
- **How it works:** the intro stands in the page itself, so it is on screen before the app's code is read. `src/startup/intro.css` and `intro.html` (written by `scripts/startup-intro.mjs` from `build/brand`) are inlined by a plugin in `vite.config.ts` and `website/vite.config.ts`. `public/startup-intro.js` and, on the site, the inlined `website/src/startupIntroHead.js` decide before the first frame whether it plays. It moves only by opacity and transform on elements of their own, so it keeps running while the bundle loads; the stitch is 25 small pictures for that reason. No words on it, the same in Russian and English.
- **End of the intro:** `src/startup/startupIntro.ts`. `endStartupIntro` is called by `AppShell` when the catalog's first load is over, by `Paywall` when the answer about access has come, by the site's entry. It always plays to its end (letters done at 1.77 s, a 0.13 s hold, a 0.35 s fade, about 2.25 s in all) and holds the last frame when loading is slower. Ceilings: 20 s in the app, then its own screen (only there can «Проверяем подписку» or «Загружаем актуальную базу» still show), 6 s on the site, whose page is already in the HTML. A failed start removes it at once (`main.tsx`, `AppErrorBoundary`). Access and subscription logic are not touched.
- **Other cases:** a reload in the app's window (a new interface build, «Перезагрузить»): the finished logo, no second show. On the site: once in a browser tab, a reload or a language switch opens at once. `prefers-reduced-motion`: the finished logo, 0.6 s. Browser automation (`navigator.webdriver`, the e2e tests): none. No View Transition while it is on screen (`pageTransitionHistory.ts`): it would freeze it in a snapshot. No scrollbar or scrolling under it. The ground is `#0d1110`, the Electron window's own colour; `capacitor.config.ts` now gives the phone's WebView the same.
- **Native splash, on its own branch:** `claude/startup-intro-native` (`a3637d17`, plain ground on the Android and iOS splash images, Android 12's splash without the icon, `scripts/brand-icons.mjs`, `docs/mobile.md`). **Not on the release path: the publisher refuses `android/` and `ios/`** (`deployPath`). Without it a phone shows the old monogram splash for a moment, then the intro. Never built: no Android SDK on this PC. The owner decides how it reaches a phone build.
- **Tests:** `npm run typecheck`, the site's `tsc`, eslint on the changed files: clean. New: `src/startup/startupIntro.test.ts`, `introPage.test.ts`, `startupIntro.e2e.ts` (4 passed against the built page), `website/src/startupIntro.test.ts`; added to `Paywall.test.tsx`, `App.test.tsx`, `pageTransitionHistory.test.ts`. Vitest without `positionTracker.test.ts`, on 0.6.0.259 with `--testTimeout=30000`: 3211 passed, 6 failed, all known (release-policy, cache-item-images, linux/updater ×3, staleServer, appVersion, AdminPanelPage sidebar); 16 more files do not load here because `server/node_modules` is not installed in this worktree (`cors`), the code they test is not touched. With the default 5 s limit the machine's load makes about 15 page tests time out; they pass alone with the longer limit.
- **Checked in a real browser (Playwright, built pages):** frames at both sizes against the variant the owner chose; PC and phone form; a main thread slowed 6 times: the animation ran with no gap over 100 ms; server not answering for 5 s: the last frame with no words, then the app; no network; no script on the site: the page after 6 s; reduced motion; reload; English: the app's English account screen and the site's `?lang=en` after the same intro. **In Electron 44 (Chrome 152), in a throwaway offscreen window with the app's window settings:** the first frame is exactly `#0d1110`, no white; the file:// page plays. ## 2026-11-06 — Site: the emblem flies to the header, the page puts itself together (branch `claude/site-opening`, shown to the owner, not released)

- **Owner's order:** «Вот этот значок переместится в то место, где у нас сейчас на сайте слева сверху [...] чтобы вся страница собралась в таком же стиле, с такой же анимацией». Waits for the owner's word on the video; no text and no news row in this branch.
- **What it does:** `website/src/siteOpening.ts`. After the intro the patch and the name fly (0.72 s, one transform each) exactly onto the header's own, a ring where they land. A stitch runs from there along the header's lower edge and the header's buttons rise out of that line as it passes them. In the page the letters of the big name rise one by one like the intro's, its stitch runs, its line rises; a stitch goes round the trailer, the trailer comes up inside it with a ring; the rest rises in reading order. The stitches fade: at rest the page is what it was. About 1.5 s from the start of the flight, about 3.4 s from the start of the page; buttons work from the first moment of the flight.
- **How it holds together:** opacity and transform only, by `element.animate`. No style hides the page: the pieces are held by animations that start in the frame the intro opens and are all dropped at the end, or after a ceiling when the window was hidden. The stitch reuses the intro's own classes. `endStartupIntro(doc, open)` takes the opening in place of the fade; an opening that cannot run or fails falls back to the fade. The app does not pass it and is unchanged.
- **Who sees it (`website/src/startupIntroHead.js`):** once in a browser (`localStorage`, was once in a tab), on `/` only, on a computer. A phone (`pointer: coarse`, up to 720 px), motion turned off, a page other than the home page, a browser that cannot remember, a visitor who comes back: the page opens at once, no intro at all. **This takes the intro off the site's phones, which had it since 0.6.0.261.**
- **Search engines:** the intro holds no text and the HTML is the same. Bots, Lighthouse and headless browsers get no intro (by user agent, and `navigator.webdriver` as before), and their visit does not count as the visitor's. Checked with the Googlebot and YandexBot user agents and with no scripts: the page at once. The largest paint on a first visit is 0.4–0.8 s: the page's entrance is finished before its first paint under the intro (`settleUnderIntro`, a layout effect); without that the speed measure saw the big name only at the end, 3.8 s. A visitor who comes back measures as before (0.2–0.5 s).

## 2026-11-06 — Site opening, second pass: smooth, the intro half the size (branch `claude/site-opening`, shown to the owner, not released)

- **Owner, on the first video:** «она очень сильно лагает [...] Каждое движение, каждая анимация» must be smooth; «уменьши интро на сайте [...] Сделай в 2 раза меньше». Read as the size on screen, not the duration; he was told so.
- **Half the size:** `website/src/startupIntroSite.css`, on top of the shared `intro.css`, inlined by `website/vite.config.ts`. The app's intro is not changed. A test holds the site's numbers at half the app's.
- **What made it rough, and what was done:** the first video itself was uneven: the offscreen window drew in software at about 47 frames a second at uneven moments. In the page: the stitches jumped from picture to picture (126 px at a time); curves that covered most of the way in the first frames; the scrollbar's return laid out the whole long page in the flight's first frame. Now: the stitches are drawn on three small canvases a little further each frame, from the same clock as the rest (`drawStitches`); gentle curves and longer moves; `scrollbar-gutter: stable` while the intro is on; the blur of the header, the cookie notice and the trailer's glow off while it runs; `overflow: clip` on the header and plain nested boxes instead of `clip-path`, so nothing is repainted; the trailer waits at its first frame and starts as it begins to show (`holdTrailer`), so it is seen from its start. The opening takes 1.65 s after the 1.9 s of the intro.
- **Measured with the machine's GPU (RTX 3060 Ti, no window, Chrome's new headless, a page's frame callbacks at about 143 a second, 1920×1080):** before: gaps of up to 49 ms at the start of the flight on each run. Now: 237 frames in 1655 ms and **no gap over 20 ms** when the browser has already drawn a page. The first page of a fresh browser has one gap of 76 ms, 83 ms into the flight, where it has moved about 2 %: drawing on a canvas under the intro changed nothing, so that attempt was taken out. Main thread 4 times slower: 21 ms gaps at most after the first page. A weak computer's own graphics were not measured.
- **The video for the owner is stepped, not filmed:** the page's clock, animations and trailer go 1/60 s per picture, so the file shows the timing exactly and cannot prove the speed of a given computer; that is what the measurements above are for.
- **Merged:** `claude/app-fixes` is in this branch; both add to the end of this log, so a merge keeps both.
- **Tests:** the site's `tsc`, `npm run typecheck`, `website/src` and `src/startup`: 194 passed. Browser checks repeated on this build: emblem 0 px from the header's own at every size and in English, nothing held at rest, phone, reduced motion, bots, no scripts, late and missing script, click and scroll while it opens.
- **Not checked:** Firefox, Safari, the site behind nginx, a weak computer. **Deployment:** none, nothing pushed.

## 2026-11-07 — Proposal №85: an eraser and colours for the map's pencil (branch `claude/proposal-85-sketch`, over 0.6.0.271, for the coming release)

- **The owner, directly:** «Проверь заявку 85 и прими ее в работу». Read in the owner's table on the site (he signed in himself in the pane): a player asks for an eraser beside the pencil and different colours. It stood «В процессе» already when opened, so «Взял в работу» was not pressed and no second window went to the author. «Готово» and «Выдать +1 дн.» are the owner's, after the release. **№80 had been «без резинки» by the owner's word; this takes that back on his «прими её в работу», which is worth his look.**
- **The eraser:** rubs out what it passes over, also what was kept earlier; a line it crosses is split in two, a whole stroke under it goes. 12 px round on screen at any zoom, measured on screen since a map's axes can have different scales and it can be turned (`createMapCrs`), so `eraseStrokes` gets a projection and cuts at the circle, however long the segment and however fast the move. Its cursor is a ring of its own size. One press to release is one step back; a press that touched nothing is no step. A second finger cancels it, as with the pencil.
- **The history changed for this:** `SketchEdit` is now `{ strokes, past, future }`, whole lists sharing their strokes, so «Назад» reaches kept strokes only by undoing the eraser; a kept stroke still cannot be taken back as such. ✕ still brings back all that was kept.
- **The colours:** six, the owner's red first and default; a stroke remembers its own, old ones stay red, an unknown value in storage is dropped. The last one stays for the next time on every map; «Удалить все данные» takes it by the prefix. A dot of the colour in the row opens the palette under it; a colour takes the pencil back from the eraser. The pencil's icon wears the colour.
- **Where:** `src/maps/mapSketch.ts`, `src/components/MapSketch.tsx`, `mapSketch.css`, `uiEnglishFeatures.ts`. `MapsPage.tsx` not touched. On a phone seven buttons did not fit: at 360 px ✕ went under the zoom buttons, so the row is narrower while drawing (`.map-sketch.is-editing`).
- **Tests:** `mapSketch.test.ts`, `MapSketch.test.tsx` and the rest of `src/maps`, `src/pages/MapsPage*`, `src/i18n`: 21 files, 89 passed; `npm run typecheck`, eslint clean. Not the whole set.

- The link: `https://raidos.app/?utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=<name>` (`src/shared/adSources.ts`: platforms, campaign cleaning, `adLink`). Per third-party guides, Reddit does not let a live ad's URL be edited: a running ad needs a copy with the new link.
- Server: POST `/v1/accounts/ad-visits` (`AccountStore.recordAdVisit`: once a day per visitor per platform on the owner's day, `ad_visit_days`; the network digest for 7 days, `ad_link_nets`, swept); registration takes `adSource`/`adCampaign` from the site (also through the e-mail code: `emailAuth.ts` payload `ad`), else the network that opened the link within 7 days — the PC app's registrations (`accounts.ad_source`, `ad_campaign`; statistics only, independent of streamer/friend codes). GET `/me/admin/ads?period=` (`AdminStore.adSources`): visits, registrations (deleted accounts not counted), succeeded payments, payers and revenue — totals, per day/month/year (Bangkok) and per campaign.
- Site: `website/src/adVisit.ts` (App start: `utm_source`/`utm_campaign` → `toc.ad` for 7 days + one POST per tab session), `api.register` sends and then forgets the label. ## 2026-11-09 — Report №104: the many map points on one canvas (branch `claude/bp-documents`, not released)

- Report №104 + owner: with containers, caches and loot on the map lagged hard; «чтобы они приклеивались к карте и были единым целым, но также нажимались. И также окошки появлялись при наведении».
- Cause: every point was its own DOM icon animated by Leaflet on a zoom; a wheel while the map glides froze for hundreds of ms.
- `src/maps/MarkerCanvasLayer.tsx` (a Leaflet `Renderer`: zoom-animated as one picture, redrawn on `moveend`/`zoomend`, hit test by the drawn boxes), `src/maps/markerSprites.ts` (one bitmap per kind: same picture, size, anchor, CSS drop-shadows, floor chip, «+N», dashed «possible» ring, key names), `src/maps/canvasPick.ts`.
- `MapsPage`: `CANVAS_LAYERS` (loot, containers, documents, keys/doors, spawns, hazards, landmarks) go on the canvas; exits, quests, bosses, switches, stationary weapons, the chosen/focused and draggable points stay DOM icons. The point under the pointer becomes its DOM icon (tooltip, click, menu); a tap on the canvas picks it (phone). jsdom has no canvas: there (`canvasMarkers` false) all stay DOM icons, so the page tests keep counting icons.
- Measured (offscreen Electron, vite dev, Customs, all layers, drag + wheel while gliding): before 596 DOM icons, 152 frames, avg 33 ms, p95 67, max 200, 23 frames > 50 ms; canvas 40 DOM icons, 276 frames, avg 17.6, p95 16.8, max 67, 1 frame > 50 ms. Before/after video sent to the owner; the sprites matched the icons on its frames.
- Tests: typecheck, eslint on the files, maps tests 85 passed. The full run's other failures are this PC's environment (positionTracker reads the real EFT screenshots folder, updater's Windows tar, staleServer, two node-test files), not touched here.
- Risks: hover/click checked by script only, not by hand; not on the phone.
